title: billing-service: verify OIDC tokens directly (retire the SBX-10 shim)

blocks.text: billing-service: verify OIDC tokens directly (retire the SBX-10 shim)
Status: Draft. Author: Ishan Sinha. Reviewers: Karthik Valluri, Dhruv Pendharkar.

billing-service receives webhooks carrying tokens from auth-service and reads tenant_id from the token to route each event to the right tenant. Today a compatibility shim in auth-service rewrites the namespaced claim back to tenant_id for the billing webhook audience.
Remove the shim, have billing-service validate OIDC ID tokens itself, and read the tenant and roles from the standard OIDC claim set.
billing-service will fetch auth-service's JWKS once at startup and cache the keys in memory for the life of the process.
To call auth-service's tenant lookup API, billing-service will get a token from the /oauth/token endpoint using client credentials.
Ship behind a flag in staging first, then switch production over the week of December 14.
Do we need an audit record of which tokens billing-service accepted?
Who owns billing-service once the shim is gone?
Reviewers: please leave comments by Friday so we can finalize the plan at the next sync.
